tabs.tab_title: Will my team actually use it?
tabs.tab_content: That’s the goal. We keep it simple, train everyone and only set up what you’ll use.

tabs.tab_title: Can you move my existing contacts?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We import and clean up your contacts, customers and open deals.

tabs.tab_title: Does it connect to my phone and email?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Calls, texts, emails and form fills can all land in the same place.

tabs.tab_title: Can I buy CRM on its own?
tabs.tab_content: No. Every service is delivered as part of a FirstSearch partnership, because CRM works best alongside the rest of your marketing system. Your plan includes every service your business needs for one fixed monthly retainer.
